conceptReview.viewerQuestion: A sequel can reuse an established system and tools; what should be retained or improved so players have a reason to play again?
claims: Existing systems/tools can reduce foundational production work, while a sequel still requires substantial content and improvement.
Prior experience affects willingness to return; repeating the same scope/content may provide insufficient reason.
Series work and new work each have value; prior structure does not guarantee sales or enjoyment.
limits: The source half-sales statement is the speaker’s generalization, not a verified universal statistic.
Automatic JA contains word/particle errors; exact words and human whole viewing/listening remain unapproved.
No development cost or player-satisfaction result is inferred from gameplay alone.
